claim: River bluff-catching begins with origin range, prior filtering and credible surviving bluff supply before blocker quality is considered.
interpretation: The learner should rebuild the value and natural bluff families that can actually reach the river rather than call because one card is an attractive blocker.
assumptions: Hero faces a river bet or raise
The prior action history materially filters ranges
exceptions: Near a genuine call/fold threshold, blocker effects can be decisive after the range audit

claim: River call quality is size-, line- and range-dependent; a hand must be classified against the actual value and bluff regions rather than by absolute hand strength.
interpretation: Value beaters, bluff catchers and frail hands can change class when the represented value range or size changes.
assumptions: The relevant opposing value and bluff regions can be described
The bet size changes the required defence threshold
exceptions: Exact hand thresholds and EVs remain visual- and solver-dependent
notes: Call and raise thresholds remain separate.

claim: A blocker can worsen a bluff-catch when it removes more of the opponent's natural bluff region than value, so a context-free 'nut blocker is best' rule is invalid.
interpretation: For calling, blockers are useful when they block value and unblock bluffs; the opposite functions are harmful.
assumptions: The opponent's relevant value and bluff families are already identified
The blocker materially removes combinations from those families
exceptions: On some textures one blocker can strongly reduce concentrated value without removing bluffs

claim: Strong evidence that a specific heavily filtered branch is underbluffed can justify folding theoretical bluff catchers, but population magnitude must remain field-gated.
interpretation: Use theory as a baseline, then override only the exact branch when credible player or pool evidence supports too little bluff supply.
assumptions: Observed or source-supported evidence points to underbluffing in that branch
exceptions: Creative or aggressive opponents can supply enough bluffs
Batumi population magnitude is not yet validated
conflicts: Exact Batumi underbluff frequency remains field-validation pending
